in_marathi.name: Chhavika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhavika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chhavika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chhavan', which means 'to shine'. This name is often given to a girl born during the auspicious hours of the day, symbolizing her radiant and shining personality.
